label: Cross-Border Capital

notes.note: T2: overlay checked; matching parcels, coin jog kept

corrections.what: Drew both parcels from one shape, the right one 121.4 px to the right of the left one, with corners averaged from both
corrections.why: DR-03 equal repeats; the catalogue calls them matching parcels. The two parcels' edges agree to 0.2 px after the shift (front widths 41.91 and 41.69 px).

corrections.what: Kept the right parcel's front-left edge jog: it runs down at x 132.2, steps right along a straight slant to x 136.5 between y 55.5 and 65.3, and continues to the bottom corner
corrections.why: Both sheets bend that edge away from the coin, keeping a 3.3 px gap. The sheet softens the two bends; the trace uses straight runs with round joins.

corrections.what: Made the coin a true circle, centre (99.57, 75.55), r 28.1
corrections.why: DR-03. The sheet's coin is 1.9 px taller than wide (upper arc fits r 27.36 at centre y 74.32, lower arc r 27.47 at 76.62); the circle stays within 0.5 px of every side.

corrections.what: Drew the dollar sign as two equal true loops (r 5.4) on one vertical axis, x 99.7, with short bars above and below
corrections.why: DR-03. The red sheet's loops measure about 5.3 to 5.7 px; its two terminals flare out about 0.8 px past the loops, which the trace leaves out.

corrections.what: Gave both arrowheads one size: barbs 8.9 px back from the tip and 9.1 px either side of the shaft, symmetric about the shaft
corrections.why: DR-03 equal repeats and symmetry. The upper head measures 8.85 x 9.31 px and the lower 8.88 x 8.88 px.

source_notes: Kept: the top-face tape seams at the sheet's own 45 deg angle, starting 0.8 px left of the front seam (the start sits inside the front edge's stroke); the parcels' slight perspective, with the top-back edge narrower than the front and the side face's back edge ending at y 62.5; the upper arrow pointing right across the gap and the lower one pointing left, vertically apart; the lower arrow stopping short of the coin. Red: the upper right-pointing arrow and the dollar sign; boxes, coin outline and the lower arrow stay black.
